title: Metheus experience pathway preflight input bundle
description: Caller-supplied inputs for validating and locally preflighting a subject-authored pathway. Cross-record identity, selection equality, and authorization are checked by runtime functions, not by this schema.

resources.description: Complete indexed resource set required by the current subject-index resolver.

selectedSourceIds.description: Explicit subject-selected source IDs; runtime preflight requires an exact match with the pathway's personal source references.
